name: session_key
description: Primary Key: user_pseudo_id.session_id or synthetic unconsented session hash

name: session_date_est
description: Session start date in Eastern Time (America/New_York) - PARTITION KEY

name: session_start_est
description: First event timestamp in Eastern Time

name: session_end_est
description: Last event timestamp in Eastern Time

name: session_duration_seconds
description: Elapsed seconds between first and last event in session

name: user_pseudo_id
description: GA4 client_id cookie or NULL/synthetic for unconsented users

name: session_id
description: Integer session counter timestamp from gtag.js

name: session_number
description: Ordinal session count for this user

name: consent_status
description: Consent state: GRANTED, DENIED, or UNKNOWN

name: is_consented
description: Binary flag: 1 if analytics_storage='YES', 0 otherwise

name: landing_page
description: Full page location of the first event in the session

name: landing_page_path
description: Normalized landing page path with query params and trailing slash stripped

name: landing_page_title
description: Page title of the first event in the session

name: exit_page
description: Page location of the final event in the session

name: page_referrer
description: HTTP referrer recorded at session start

name: page_views
description: Count of page_view events during the session

name: event_count
description: Total event count during the session

name: marketing_channel
description: Centralized channel mapped via fn_map_marketing_channel (e.g. Strategic Partnerships, Paid Search, Email)

name: utm_source
description: Cleaned and lowercased source

name: utm_medium
description: Cleaned and lowercased medium

name: utm_campaign
description: Cleaned and lowercased campaign name

name: utm_term
description: Cleaned and lowercased keyword/term

name: utm_content
description: Cleaned and lowercased ad content

name: utm_id
description: Cleaned and lowercased campaign id

name: utm_source_platform
description: Cleaned and lowercased source platform

name: utm_creative_format
description: Cleaned and lowercased creative format

name: utm_marketing_tactic
description: Cleaned and lowercased marketing tactic

name: device_category
description: Device category: desktop, mobile, tablet

name: device_os
description: Operating system: Android, iOS, Windows, Mac

name: device_browser
description: Browser: Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox

name: geo_country
description: Country of the visitor

name: geo_region
description: State / Province / Region

name: geo_city
description: City of the visitor

name: has_view_item
description: 1 if session viewed product page, 0 otherwise

name: has_add_to_cart
description: 1 if session triggered add_to_cart, 0 otherwise

name: has_checkout
description: 1 if session began checkout, 0 otherwise

name: has_purchase
description: 1 if session completed purchase, 0 otherwise

name: has_newsletter_signup
description: 1 if session triggered newsletter/lead signup, 0 otherwise

name: total_purchase_revenue
description: Sum of purchase revenue generated in session

name: total_items_purchased
description: Sum of units purchased in session

name: transactions_count
description: Number of completed transactions in session

name: processed_at
description: ETL load timestamp
